title: Panasonic - How to Troubleshoot Netflix Not Working
description: In the following Video we will provide you with information on how to troubleshoot when Netflix is not working on your television.  For more information on Netflix contact Netflix at https://help.netflix.com/en

asr.full_text: How to Troubleshoot Netflix Not Working properly, there may be an issue with your DNS setting or Netflix app registration. This video will help you troubleshoot the issue in 3 easy steps. Step 1 Go to the Network menu of your TV and change the DNS setting to 8.8.8.8 The menu location of the DNS setting may vary depending on your model, so check the manual of your TV if you're unsure of how to do this. Step 2 If you're still getting a Netflix error message, use the navigational buttons on your TV remote to press up, up, down, down, left, right, left, right, Up, Up, Up, Up. If done correctly, a deactivation screen will appear. If the screen doesn't appear, repeat step two again. Step 3. Follow the on-screen prompts to deactivate your account. Once you've successfully deactivated your account, select Menber-Sign in and log back into your Netflix account. If the Netflix app still doesn't load your account visit help.netflix.com for more help. This concludes the how to troubleshoot Netflix not working video. Thank you for watching. I wish you the best of luck to make your dreams come true! See you in April!
